title: SOM v0.3.1 PROPOSED — som.telling.* event payloads
description: Payloads for telling.started / telling.ended / telling.exposed (v0.3.1 Proposal §3.2), implementing the ratified event-pair semantics (§5): exposure_start/exposure_end immutable and event-stamped; scheduled_start mutable; instantaneous exposures carry both with exposure_start = exposure_end. Stuck-LIVE guard and clock discipline are normative in §5.

link_id.description: The link this Telling followed from — referenced, not duplicated

scheduled_start.description: Mutable intended-air; never used to derive on-air state
